description: Build (or return the cached, under 24 h) record for one organization id from search_organizations, e.g. sx:sec:0000320193 or sx:irs:530196605. Every fact carries as_of and the source_url of the filing it came from; failed or empty sources are listed in gaps. No key: single records, pages, feeds and bulk files are free; cross-company search and the live stream cost $0.002 a call via x402. Free key: 1,000 calls a month, no card. Paid keys from $39/month. Organizations only.
name: get_organization_record
title: Get an organization record built from public filings
